full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of the Rule are, that the petitioner herein as plaintiff No. 2 along with his father Jeabat Ali, since deceased, as plaintiff No.1, instituted a Title Suit No. 60 of 1965 on 27-11-65 for declaration of their riyati interest and for confirmation of possession from beyond the statutory period of limitation with regard to the suit pond and for permanent injunction restraining the defendants from entering into the suit pond and from giving any fencing and/or any obstruction and also from cutting any trees and enjoying any fruits and from catching any fish from the suit pond. The suit land described in the schedule as RS Plot No. 1362 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 333 having an area of 1 Kani 2 gandas and the nature of the suit land is pond and its bank.
